_doc: The event system exists to make stories out of mechanics that already exist. Every event's `effect` block is applied by EventManager against systems that were already there - none of these needs bespoke code.

broken_plate.name: Broken Plate
broken_plate.text: A plate goes down. Everyone in the room pretends not to look.

food_spill.name: Spill
food_spill.text: Something orange is on the floor. It was not there a second ago.

dropped_coin.name: Dropped Coin
dropped_coin.text: A customer drops a coin and does not notice. You notice.

pantry_raid.name: Pantry Raid
pantry_raid.text: An ingredient is missing. Gloop is nearby, looking innocent and slightly larger.

kitchen_fire.name: Kitchen Fire
kitchen_fire.text: The pan goes up. You have about three seconds of dignity left.

customer_argument.name: Disagreement
customer_argument.text: Two customers discover they have opinions about each other.

stove_trouble.name: Stove Trouble
stove_trouble.text: The range coughs, drops to a sulk, and refuses to hold heat.

famous_critic.name: A Famous Guest
famous_critic.text: Someone important just sat down. You can tell by how quiet it got.

health_inspection.name: Inspection
health_inspection.text: A clipboard walks in. The clipboard has opinions.

bulk_order.name: Bulk Order
bulk_order.text: A party of six. All the same dish. All at once. Good luck.

magical_anomaly.name: Magical Anomaly
magical_anomaly.text: Every dish on the pass is briefly, gloriously perfect. Nobody knows why.

legendary_visitor.name: The Old Regular
legendary_visitor.text: Something very old sits at the corner table and orders exactly what your aunt used to make.

quiet_night.name: A Quiet Night
quiet_night.text: Nobody comes for a while. The lamps hum. It is not unpleasant.
